cache_treatment.caveat: Samples are not classified as cold-cache measurements; host filesystem-cache state is uncontrolled.
cache_treatment.fixture_paths: Every migration and ingest sample uses a fresh TempDir database path.
cache_treatment.migration: A schema-25 database is closed before the timed schema-26 Engine::open. The harness does not attempt privileged OS page-cache eviction.
cache_treatment.query: 1 unrecorded Engine::search_text_only_with_limit calls warm each scenario's reader/process path before 3 recorded calls.

control.with_indexes: Fresh schema-26 database with both Slice 19 indexes present.
control.without_indexes: Fresh schema-26 database, closed, then both Slice 19 indexes removed with rusqlite before reopening. This deliberately altered database is a diagnostic control, not a supported production state.

generator.description: 500 active nodes and 500 body-bearing edges. Every body matches slice19needle; per-row payload is a SplitMix64-style deterministic transform of the seed and row index.

limitations: This is a deterministic synthetic fixture, not a corpus-scale, workload-representative benchmark.
The result does not assert a CI latency target, production throughput target, or generalized speedup.
Only the public Engine write and text-search paths are timed; the direct SQLite index removal exists solely to create the diagnostic no-index control.

schema.construction: Each migration sample opens an empty path with Engine::open_with_migrations_for_test and migrations 1..=25, ingests the deterministic fixture with Engine::write, closes it, then times Engine::open at head (step 26 only).

semantic_equivalence.method: The full ordered public Engine::search_text_only_with_limit result signature (write cursor, kind, body, branch) is equal between controls and across repeats.
